# pvecli deploy

Deploy the VMs and containers described in a YAML file.

The whole file is checked on every cluster before anything is written.
A guest whose name exists on its cluster is skipped, never overwritten.
Passwords only come from environment variables (password_env).

```text
pvecli deploy FILE [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `FILE` | YAML file describing the guests. |

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-dr`, `--dry-run` |  | Check everything and show the plan, create nothing. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip confirmation. |
| `--parallel N` | `4` | Guests created at the same time. |
| `-wi`, `--wait-ip N` | `0` | Seconds to wait for each guest's IPv4 address (0: don't). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile of the guests that name none in the file. |

## Examples

```bash
pvecli deploy lab.yaml --dry-run
pvecli deploy lab.yaml -y --parallel 8 --wait-ip 120
```
